text:
morgan: Heads up — planning to land PR #18321 but just noticed a scheduled DB eviction/maintenance window starting in ~30m. Can someone confirm if we should hold the merge until after the window? I can also try a rerun of CI if that helps :hourglass_flowing_sand:
kasim: if it's a hard eviction window, we should avoid merges that touch migrations. Does #18321 include any schema change?
morgan: no schema changes, just a refactor and a small feature flag. But CI has been flaky — integration-postgres job failed twice. Paste of last failing lines:
```
=== FAIL: TestUserIndex/Fallback (0.12s)
assertions.go:123: expected rows 1 but got 0
--- FAIL: TestUserIndex (0.12s)
```
kasim: ok, that looks like a flaky assertion. If we rerun and it's green twice we can probably land before blackout, but I'd rather not if the maintenance might evict connections mid-migration. Since no migrations, risk is lower.
evelyn: I'd prefer to hold until after the window unless the release lead says otherwise. We had a partial rollback last month during a maintenance window and it was messy.
samir: I'm on the release schedule — the maintenance window is inbound at 15:00 UTC for ~45m (cluster eviction). No merges that touch DB-heavy code until 16:00UTC please. If this PR is low-risk and CI passes twice, we can opt for an expedited manual check at 14:45 and land before 15:00, but only with approver+release lead sign-off.
morgan: thanks — i'll trigger a rerun now and leave it paused for manual approval if green. pinging @kasim for approval if it stays stable.
deploy-bot: CI update: integration-postgres #4567 rerun started (build 789). Logs: https://ci.redwood/example/build/789
kasim: acked, i'll watch the rerun. If it flakes again let's just queue it for after 16:00.
morgan: rerun is green on unit + integration but flaky e2e still failing in unrelated suite. I'll isolate and push a fix to avoid touching the merge window. Will request approval once I cut the tiny fix branch.
samir: thanks for the plan. to confirm — do not merge before 16:00 unless you explicitly get my +1. Also add the label "hold:maintenance" so ops filters it out.
morgan: added label and set status to "awaiting-release-lead". Will update here once fix branch is up.
evelyn: perfect, thank you. :white_check_mark:
morgan: quick update — small fix pushed to PR, rerunning e2e. If green i'll request a quick approval and we can decide based on timing. If it lands too close to the window i'll wait for 16:05.
deploy-bot: CI update: e2e suite rerun failed (flaky-test-42). See snippet: "timeout waiting for db conn". Suggest increasing wait in test harness.
kasim: that looks infra-related, not the PR itself. Let's not rush. I can take a look at the test harness tomorrow morning if you want.
morgan: agree — pausing merge until after the maintenance. I'll pick this up post-window and re-run full CI then. Thanks everyone for quick responses. :bow:
